  inherited Create;
  FGraph := Graph;
  FConfig.SetDefaults;
  FTotalSteps := 0;
  FMatcher := nil;
  FRewriter := nil;
end;

destructor TGrispRuntimeEngine.Destroy;
begin
  FreeAndNil(FRewriter);
  FreeAndNil(FMatcher);
  inherited Destroy;
end;

procedure TGrispRuntimeEngine.EnsureMatcherRewriter;
begin
  if FMatcher = nil then
    FMatcher := TGrispPatternMatcher.Create(FGraph);
  if FRewriter = nil then
    FRewriter := TGrispRewriter.Create(FGraph);
end;

procedure TGrispRuntimeEngine.LogTrace(const Msg: string);
begin
  if FConfig.TraceEnabled and Assigned(FTrace) then
    FTrace.Add(Msg);
end;

function TGrispRuntimeEngine.GetRulePhase(Rule: TGrispNode): Integer;
var
  PhaseAttr: TGrispValue;
begin
  Result := 0;
  if Rule.HasAttribute('phase') then
  begin
    PhaseAttr := Rule.GetValueAttribute('phase');
    if (PhaseAttr <> nil) and (PhaseAttr.Kind = gvkNumber) then
      Result := Trunc(PhaseAttr.NumberValue);
  end;
end;

procedure TGrispRuntimeEngine.Reset;
begin
  FTotalSteps := 0;
  if FConfig.AutoCleanup then
  begin
    FreeAndNil(FRewriter);
    FreeAndNil(FMatcher);
  end;
end;

procedure TGrispRuntimeEngine.SetConfig(const Config: TGrispRuntimeConfig);
begin
  FConfig := Config;
end;

function TGrispRuntimeEngine.Run(MaxSteps: Integer): Integer;
var
  Steps: Integer;
  ActualMaxSteps: Integer;
begin
  Result := 0;
  if FGraph = nil then Exit;

  ActualMaxSteps := MaxSteps;
  if ActualMaxSteps = 0 then
    ActualMaxSteps := FConfig.MaxSteps;

  EnsureMatcherRewriter;

  Steps := 0;
  try
    Result := RunWithTrace(nil, ActualMaxSteps);
  finally
    FTotalSteps := Steps;
  end;
end;

function TGrispRuntimeEngine.RunWithTrace(Trace: TStrings; MaxSteps: Integer): Integer;
var
  Step: Integer;
  Changed: Boolean;
  Rule: TGrispNode;
  Applied: Integer;
  ActualMaxSteps: Integer;
  i: Integer;
begin
  Result := 0;
  if FGraph = nil then Exit;

  FTrace := Trace;
  ActualMaxSteps := MaxSteps;
  if ActualMaxSteps = 0 then
    ActualMaxSteps := FConfig.MaxSteps;

  EnsureMatcherRewriter;

  Step := 0;
  try
    repeat
      Changed := False;

      for i := 0 to FGraph.Rules.Count - 1 do
      begin
        Rule := FGraph.Rules[i];
        FMatcher.SetCurrentRule(Rule);
        Applied := FRewriter.ApplyAllMatches(Rule, FMatcher, FTrace);

        if Applied > 0 then
        begin
          Inc(Step, Applied);
          Changed := True;

          LogTrace(Format('Step %d: applied %s (%d matches)', [Step, Rule.Name, Applied]));

          if Step >= ActualMaxSteps then
            Break;
        end;
      end;

    until (not Changed) or (Step >= ActualMaxSteps);

    Result := Step;
  finally
    FTrace := nil;
    if FConfig.AutoCleanup then
    begin
      FreeAndNil(FRewriter);
      FreeAndNil(FMatcher);
    end;
  end;
end;

function TGrispRuntimeEngine.RunWithPhases(MaxPhases: Integer; MaxStepsPerPhase: Integer): Integer;
begin
  Result := RunWithPhasesAndTrace(nil, MaxPhases, MaxStepsPerPhase);
end;

function TGrispRuntimeEngine.RunWithPhasesAndTrace(Trace: TStrings; MaxPhases: Integer; MaxStepsPerPhase: Integer): Integer;
var
  Phase: Integer;
  PhaseSteps: Integer;
  Changed: Boolean;
  Rule: TGrispNode;
  Applied: Integer;
  RulePhase: Integer;
  TotalSteps: Integer;
  ActualMaxPhases: Integer;
  ActualMaxStepsPerPhase: Integer;
  i: Integer;
begin
  Result := 0;
  TotalSteps := 0;

  if FGraph = nil then Exit;

  FTrace := Trace;
  ActualMaxPhases := MaxPhases;
  if ActualMaxPhases = 0 then
    ActualMaxPhases := FConfig.MaxPhases;

  ActualMaxStepsPerPhase := MaxStepsPerPhase;
  if ActualMaxStepsPerPhase = 0 then
	ActualMaxStepsPerPhase := FConfig.MaxStepsPerPhase;

  EnsureMatcherRewriter;

  try
    for Phase := 1 to ActualMaxPhases do
    begin
      LogTrace(Format('========== PHASE %d ==========', [Phase]));
      PhaseSteps := 0;

      repeat
        Changed := False;

        for i := 0 to FGraph.Rules.Count - 1 do
        begin
          Rule := FGraph.Rules[i];
          RulePhase := GetRulePhase(Rule);

          if (RulePhase = 0) or (RulePhase = Phase) then
          begin
            FMatcher.SetCurrentRule(Rule);
            Applied := FRewriter.ApplyAllMatches(Rule, FMatcher, FTrace);

            if Applied > 0 then
            begin
              Inc(PhaseSteps, Applied);
              Changed := True;

              LogTrace(Format('  Phase %d, Step %d: %s (%d matches)',
                       [Phase, PhaseSteps, Rule.Name, Applied]));

              if PhaseSteps >= ActualMaxStepsPerPhase then
                Break;
            end;
          end;
        end;

        if PhaseSteps >= ActualMaxStepsPerPhase then
          Break;

      until not Changed;

      LogTrace(Format('Phase %d complete after %d steps', [Phase, PhaseSteps]));
      Inc(TotalSteps, PhaseSteps);

      if PhaseSteps = 0 then
        Break;
    end;

    Result := TotalSteps;

  finally
    FTrace := nil;
    if FConfig.AutoCleanup then
    begin
      FreeAndNil(FRewriter);
      FreeAndNil(FMatcher);
    end;
  end;
end;

function TGrispRuntimeEngine.RunUntilStable(MaxSteps: Integer): Integer;
begin
  Result := Run(MaxSteps);
end;

end.

unit unit_Strategy_TGrispStrategyBuilder_version_001;

interface

type
  TGrispStrategyBuilder = class
  private
    FRoot: TGrispStrategy;
    FCurrentParent: TGrispStrategy;
    FScopeStack: TStack<TGrispStrategy>;
    FDebugEnabled: Boolean;

    procedure Debug(const Msg: string);
    procedure DebugEnter(const Method: string);

	procedure WrapLastStrategy(Kind: TGrispStrategyKind; PhaseNum: Integer = 0);
  public

    destructor Destroy; override;

    procedure DisableDebug;

    function Rule(const RuleName: string): TGrispStrategyBuilder;
    function Sequence: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
    function EndScope: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
    function RepeatStrategy: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
    function TryStrategy: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
    function Choice: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
    function Phase(PhaseNum: Integer): TGrispStrategyBuilder;

  end;

  FScopeStack.Free;
  inherited Destroy;

procedure TGrispStrategyBuilder.EnableDebug;
begin
  FDebugEnabled := True;
  TGrispDebug.Enable;
  Debug('=== Fixed StrategyBuilder DEBUG ENABLED ===');
end;

begin
  Debug('=== Fixed StrategyBuilder DEBUG DISABLED ===');
  FDebugEnabled := False;
end;

procedure TGrispStrategyBuilder.Debug(const Msg: string);

  if FDebugEnabled then
    TGrispDebug.Log('[FixedBuilder] ' + Msg);
end;

begin
  if FDebugEnabled then
    TGrispDebug.LogEnter('[FixedBuilder] ' + Method);

begin
  if FDebugEnabled then
    TGrispDebug.LogExit('[FixedBuilder] ' + Method);

procedure TGrispStrategyBuilder.DumpStrategy(Strategy: TGrispStrategy; Indent: Integer = 0);
var
  i: Integer;
  IndentStr: string;
begin
  if not FDebugEnabled then Exit;

  IndentStr := StringOfChar(' ', Indent * 2);
  case Strategy.Kind of
    gskRule:
      Debug(Format('%sRule: %s', [IndentStr, Strategy.RuleName]));
    gskSequence:
      begin
        Debug(Format('%sSequence (%d children)', [IndentStr, Strategy.Strategies.Count]));
        for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
          DumpStrategy(Strategy.Strategies[i], Indent + 1);
      end;
    gskRepeat:
      begin
        Debug(Format('%sRepeat (%d children)', [IndentStr, Strategy.Strategies.Count]));
        for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
          DumpStrategy(Strategy.Strategies[i], Indent + 1);
      end;
    gskTry:
      begin
        Debug(Format('%sTry (%d children)', [IndentStr, Strategy.Strategies.Count]));
        for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
          DumpStrategy(Strategy.Strategies[i], Indent + 1);
      end;
    gskChoice:
      begin
        Debug(Format('%sChoice (%d children)', [IndentStr, Strategy.Strategies.Count]));
        for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
          DumpStrategy(Strategy.Strategies[i], Indent + 1);
      end;
    gskPhase:
      begin
        Debug(Format('%sPhase %d (%d children)', [IndentStr, Strategy.Phase, Strategy.Strategies.Count]));
        for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
          DumpStrategy(Strategy.Strategies[i], Indent + 1);
      end;
  end;
end;

procedure TGrispStrategyBuilder.DumpState(const Prefix: string);
begin
  if not FDebugEnabled then Exit;
  Debug(Format('%s Root: %s, CurrentParent: %s, ScopeStack depth: %d', [
    Prefix,
    BoolToStr(FRoot <> nil, True),
    BoolToStr(FCurrentParent <> nil, True),
    FScopeStack.Count
  ]));
  if FRoot <> nil then
    DumpStrategy(FRoot, 1);
end;

procedure TGrispStrategyBuilder.Clear;
begin
  DebugEnter('Clear');
  FRoot.Free;
  FRoot := nil;
  FCurrentParent := nil;
  FScopeStack.Clear;
  DumpState('After Clear');
  DebugExit('Clear');
end;

procedure TGrispStrategyBuilder.AddStrategy(Strategy: TGrispStrategy);
begin
  if FRoot = nil then
  begin
    FRoot := Strategy;
    FCurrentParent := Strategy;
    Debug('Added as root');
  end
  else if (FRoot.Kind = gskRule) and (FCurrentParent = FRoot) then
  begin
    // Multiple root rules - wrap in sequence
    Debug('Multiple root rules detected - wrapping in sequence');
    var NewSequence := TGrispStrategy.Create(gskSequence);
    NewSequence.Strategies.Add(FRoot);
    NewSequence.Strategies.Add(Strategy);
    FRoot := NewSequence;
    FCurrentParent := NewSequence;
    Debug('Created sequence with both rules');
  end
  else if FCurrentParent <> nil then
  begin
    FCurrentParent.Strategies.Add(Strategy);
    Debug(Format('Added to parent %s', [GetEnumName(TypeInfo(TGrispStrategyKind), Ord(FCurrentParent.Kind))]));
  end
  else
  begin
    Debug('ERROR: No current parent for strategy');
    Strategy.Free;
    raise Exception.Create('No current parent for strategy');
  end;
end;

procedure TGrispStrategyBuilder.WrapLastStrategy(Kind: TGrispStrategyKind; PhaseNum: Integer = 0);
var
  Last: TGrispStrategy;
  Wrapper: TGrispStrategy;
begin
  Debug(Format('Wrapping last strategy with %s', [GetEnumName(TypeInfo(TGrispStrategyKind), Ord(Kind))]));

  if FRoot = nil then
  begin
    case Kind of
      gskRepeat:
        raise Exception.Create('RepeatStrategy requires a preceding strategy');
      gskTry:
        raise Exception.Create('TryStrategy requires a preceding strategy');
      gskChoice:
        raise Exception.Create('Choice requires a preceding strategy');
      gskPhase:
        raise Exception.Create('Phase requires a preceding strategy');
    else
      raise Exception.Create('No strategy to wrap');
    end;
  end;

  // If current parent has children, wrap the last child
  if (FCurrentParent <> nil) and (FCurrentParent.Strategies.Count > 0) then
  begin
    Last := FCurrentParent.Strategies.Last;
    Debug(Format('Wrapping child strategy: %s', [GetEnumName(TypeInfo(TGrispStrategyKind), Ord(Last.Kind))]));

    Wrapper := TGrispStrategy.Create(Kind);
    if Kind = gskPhase then
      Wrapper.Phase := PhaseNum;
    Wrapper.Strategies.Add(Last);

    FCurrentParent.Strategies.Delete(FCurrentParent.Strategies.Count - 1);
    FCurrentParent.Strategies.Add(Wrapper);
    Debug('Created wrapper and replaced child');
  end
  // Otherwise, wrap the root itself
  else if FRoot <> nil then
  begin
    Debug('Wrapping root strategy');
    Last := FRoot;
    Debug(Format('Root strategy: %s', [GetEnumName(TypeInfo(TGrispStrategyKind), Ord(Last.Kind))]));

    Wrapper := TGrispStrategy.Create(Kind);
    if Kind = gskPhase then
      Wrapper.Phase := PhaseNum;
    Wrapper.Strategies.Add(Last);

    FRoot := Wrapper;
    FCurrentParent := Wrapper;
    Debug('Created wrapper and replaced root');
  end
  else
  begin
    // This case should never be reached because FRoot is checked above
    raise Exception.Create('No strategy to wrap');
  end;
end;

function TGrispStrategyBuilder.Rule(const RuleName: string): TGrispStrategyBuilder;
var
  Strategy: TGrispStrategy;
begin
  DebugEnter('Rule');
  Debug(Format('Adding rule: %s', [RuleName]));
  Strategy := TGrispStrategy.Create(gskRule);
  Strategy.RuleName := RuleName;
  AddStrategy(Strategy);
  DumpState('After Rule');
  DebugExit('Rule');
  Result := Self;
end;

function TGrispStrategyBuilder.Sequence: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
var
  Strategy: TGrispStrategy;
begin
  DebugEnter('Sequence');
  Debug('Adding sequence - opening new scope');

  Strategy := TGrispStrategy.Create(gskSequence);

  FScopeStack.Push(FCurrentParent);

  if FRoot = nil then
  begin
    FRoot := Strategy;
    FCurrentParent := Strategy;
    Debug('Sequence is root');
  end
  else if FCurrentParent <> nil then
  begin
    FCurrentParent.Strategies.Add(Strategy);
    FCurrentParent := Strategy;
    Debug('Sequence added as child and becomes current parent');
  end
  else
  begin
    Debug('ERROR: Cannot add sequence - no context');
    Strategy.Free;
    raise Exception.Create('Cannot add sequence - no context');
  end;

  DumpState('After Sequence');
  DebugExit('Sequence');
  Result := Self;
end;

function TGrispStrategyBuilder.EndScope: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
begin
  DebugEnter('EndScope');

  if FScopeStack.Count = 0 then
  begin
    Debug('ERROR: EndScope called with no open scope');
    raise Exception.Create('EndScope called with no open scope');
  end;

  FCurrentParent := FScopeStack.Pop;
  Debug('Closed scope');
  DumpState('After EndScope');
  DebugExit('EndScope');
  Result := Self;
end;

function TGrispStrategyBuilder.RepeatStrategy: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
begin
  DebugEnter('RepeatStrategy');
  WrapLastStrategy(gskRepeat);
  DumpState('After RepeatStrategy');
  DebugExit('RepeatStrategy');
  Result := Self;
end;

function TGrispStrategyBuilder.TryStrategy: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
begin
  DebugEnter('TryStrategy');
  WrapLastStrategy(gskTry);
  DumpState('After TryStrategy');
  DebugExit('TryStrategy');
  Result := Self;
end;

function TGrispStrategyBuilder.Choice: TGrispStrategyBuilder;
begin
  DebugEnter('Choice');
  WrapLastStrategy(gskChoice);
  DumpState('After Choice');
  DebugExit('Choice');
  Result := Self;
end;

function TGrispStrategyBuilder.Phase(PhaseNum: Integer): TGrispStrategyBuilder;
begin
  DebugEnter('Phase');
  Debug(Format('Phase number: %d', [PhaseNum]));
  WrapLastStrategy(gskPhase, PhaseNum);
  DumpState('After Phase');
  DebugExit('Phase');
  Result := Self;
end;

function TGrispStrategyBuilder.Build: TGrispStrategy;
begin
  DebugEnter('Build');
  DumpState('Before Build');

  if FRoot = nil then
  begin
	Debug('ERROR: No strategies to build');
	raise Exception.Create('No strategies to build');
  end;

  if FScopeStack.Count > 0 then
  begin
    Debug('WARNING: Unclosed scopes exist');
	while FScopeStack.Count > 0 do
	  EndScope;
  end;

  Result := FRoot;
  FRoot := nil;
  FCurrentParent := nil;
  FScopeStack.Clear;

  Debug('Final strategy tree:');
  DumpStrategy(Result, 1);

  DebugExit('Build');
end;

end.

unit unit_Strategy_TGrispStrategyEngine_version_001;

interface

uses
  System.SysUtils,
  System.Classes,
  System.Generics.Collections,
  unit_Graph_TGrispGraph_version_001,
  unit_Graph_TGrispEdge_TGrispNode_version_001,
  unit_Pattern_TGrispPatternMatcher_version_001,
  unit_Rewrite_TGrispRewriter_version_001,
  unit_Strategy_TGrispStrategyKind_version_001,
  unit_Strategy_TGrispStrategy_version_001;

type
  TGrispStrategyEngine = class
  private
	FGraph: TGrispGraph;
    FMatcher: TGrispPatternMatcher;
    FRewriter: TGrispRewriter;
    FStrategies: TDictionary<string, TGrispStrategy>;  // Non-owning reference
    FTrace: TStrings;
    FMaxSteps: Integer;
    FCurrentSteps: Integer;

    function ExecuteStrategy(Strategy: TGrispStrategy): Boolean;
    function FindRule(const RuleName: string): TGrispNode;
    procedure ResetSteps;
  public
    constructor Create(Graph: TGrispGraph);
    destructor Destroy; override;

    function Execute(const StrategyName: string; MaxSteps: Integer = 1000): Integer;
    function ExecuteWithTrace(const StrategyName: string; Trace: TStrings; MaxSteps: Integer = 1000): Integer;

    property Trace: TStrings read FTrace write FTrace;
    property MaxSteps: Integer read FMaxSteps write FMaxSteps;
  end;

implementation

constructor TGrispStrategyEngine.Create(Graph: TGrispGraph);
var
  Pair: TPair<string, TGrispStrategy>;
begin
  inherited Create;
  FGraph := Graph;
  FMatcher := TGrispPatternMatcher.Create(Graph);
  FRewriter := TGrispRewriter.Create(Graph);
  FStrategies := TDictionary<string, TGrispStrategy>.Create;

  // Load strategies from the graph (non-owning references)
  for Pair in Graph.Strategies do
    FStrategies.Add(Pair.Key, Pair.Value);

  FMaxSteps := 1000;
  FCurrentSteps := 0;
end;

destructor TGrispStrategyEngine.Destroy;
begin
  // Do NOT free the strategies - they are owned by the graph
  FStrategies.Free;
  FRewriter.Free;
  FMatcher.Free;
  inherited Destroy;
end;

function TGrispStrategyEngine.FindRule(const RuleName: string): TGrispNode;
var
  Node: TGrispNode;
  i: Integer;
begin
  Result := nil;
  for i := 0 to FGraph.Rules.Count - 1 do
  begin
    Node := FGraph.Rules[i];
    if SameText(Node.Name, RuleName) then
      Exit(Node);
  end;
end;

procedure TGrispStrategyEngine.ResetSteps;
begin
  FCurrentSteps := 0;
end;

function TGrispStrategyEngine.ExecuteStrategy(Strategy: TGrispStrategy): Boolean;
var
  SubStrategy: TGrispStrategy;
  Rule: TGrispNode;
  Applied: Integer;
  Changed: Boolean;
  OldPhase: Integer;
  i: Integer;
begin
  Result := False;

  if FCurrentSteps >= FMaxSteps then
    Exit;

  case Strategy.Kind of
    gskRule:
      begin
        Rule := FindRule(Strategy.RuleName);
        if Assigned(Rule) then
        begin
          FMatcher.SetCurrentRule(Rule);
          Applied := FRewriter.ApplyAllMatches(Rule, FMatcher, FTrace);
          if Applied > 0 then
          begin
            Inc(FCurrentSteps, Applied);
            Result := True;
          end;
        end;
      end;

    gskRepeat:
      begin
        repeat
          Changed := False;
          for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
          begin
            SubStrategy := Strategy.Strategies[i];
            if ExecuteStrategy(SubStrategy) then
              Changed := True;
            if FCurrentSteps >= FMaxSteps then
              Break;
          end;
        until (not Changed) or (FCurrentSteps >= FMaxSteps);
        Result := Changed;
      end;

    gskSequence:
      begin
        for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
        begin
          SubStrategy := Strategy.Strategies[i];
          if ExecuteStrategy(SubStrategy) then
            Result := True;
          if FCurrentSteps >= FMaxSteps then
            Break;
        end;
      end;

    gskTry:
      begin
        for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
        begin
		  SubStrategy := Strategy.Strategies[i];
          if ExecuteStrategy(SubStrategy) then
          begin
            Result := True;
            Break;
          end;
        end;
      end;

    gskChoice:
      begin
        for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
        begin
          SubStrategy := Strategy.Strategies[i];
          if ExecuteStrategy(SubStrategy) then
            Result := True;
          if FCurrentSteps >= FMaxSteps then
            Break;
        end;
      end;

    gskPhase:
      begin
        OldPhase := FMatcher.CurrentPhase;
        try
          FMatcher.SetPhase(Strategy.Phase);
          for i := 0 to Strategy.Strategies.Count - 1 do
          begin
            SubStrategy := Strategy.Strategies[i];
            if ExecuteStrategy(SubStrategy) then
              Result := True;
            if FCurrentSteps >= FMaxSteps then
              Break;
          end;
        finally
          FMatcher.SetPhase(OldPhase);
        end;
      end;
  end;
end;

function TGrispStrategyEngine.Execute(const StrategyName: string; MaxSteps: Integer): Integer;
var
  Strategy: TGrispStrategy;
begin
  Result := 0;
  FMaxSteps := MaxSteps;
  ResetSteps;

  if not FStrategies.TryGetValue(StrategyName, Strategy) then
    Exit;

  ExecuteStrategy(Strategy);
  Result := FCurrentSteps;
end;

function TGrispStrategyEngine.ExecuteWithTrace(const StrategyName: string; Trace: TStrings; MaxSteps: Integer): Integer;
begin
  FTrace := Trace;
  try
    Result := Execute(StrategyName, MaxSteps);
  finally
    FTrace := nil;
  end;
end;

end.

# Contributing to GRISP

Thank you for your interest in contributing to GRISP!

GRISP is an experimental AI‑native programming language, and contributions are welcome in the following areas:

- Parser improvements  
- Pattern matcher enhancements  
- Rewrite engine optimizations  
- Visualization tools  
- Documentation  
- Example programs  
- Bug fixes  
- Performance improvements  

---

## How to Contribute

### 1. Fork the repository  
Create your own fork and clone it locally.

### 2. Create a feature branch  
git checkout -b feature/my-improvement

Code

### 3. Make your changes  
Follow the existing coding style and naming conventions.

### 4. Add tests  
All new features must include tests in `GrispTestProject.dpr`.

### 5. Submit a pull request  
Describe your changes clearly and reference any related issues.

---

## Coding Guidelines

- Use clear, descriptive names  
- Keep units small and focused  
- Avoid unnecessary complexity  
- Maintain deterministic behavior  
- Ensure all graph modifications are explicit and safe  

---

## Reporting Issues

Please include:

- Steps to reproduce  
- Expected behavior  
- Actual behavior  
- Code samples or G‑Blocks snippets  

---

## Thank You

Your contributions help shape the future of AI‑native programming.

<body>
G-Blocks: A Universal Typed Graph Expression Format
Specification Version 1.0
==================================================

1. Introduction
---------------

G-Blocks are a typed, declarative, graph-structured representation format
designed for expressing data, computation, and relationships in a way that is:

- crystal clear
- strongly typed
- unambiguous
- scalable
- universal
- LLM-friendly
- implementation-friendly (e.g. Delphi, C, Go)
- GRISP-native (graph rewrite information symbolic processor)

G-Blocks unify the readability of block-structured languages with the expressive
power of graph-based computation.

They are suitable for:

- tool interfaces
- symbolic computation
- configuration
- data modeling
- protocol definitions
- AI-model interaction
- graph rewriting systems
- GRISP-style information processing


2. Core Concepts
----------------

2.1 Nodes
---------

A node is the fundamental unit of structure.

Syntax:

  node <NodeName> {
      ...
  }

A node represents:

- an entity
- a concept
- a tool
- a value container
- a graph vertex

Node names are identifiers using standard programming-language conventions
(e.g. letters, digits, underscore, starting with a letter or underscore).


2.2 Edges
---------

Inside a node block, each line defines an edge:

  <EdgeName>: <Type> = <Value>

An edge is a typed, labeled connection from the node to a value or another node.

Edges are:

- explicit
- strongly typed
- unambiguous


2.3 Types
---------

G-Blocks support a minimal but extensible type system:

- number
- string
- boolean
- identifier
- array<T>
- node (nested block)

Examples:

  a: number
  name: string
  flag: boolean
  tool: identifier
  items: array<number>
  metadata: node

Future extensions may include (but are not limited to):

- map<K,V>
- tuple<T1,T2,...>
- optional<T>
- union<T1|T2>
- range<T>
- set<T>


2.4 Values
----------

Values must match their declared type.

Examples:

  a: number = 5
  b: string = "Hello"
  flag: boolean = true
  tool: identifier = tool.math.add
  items: array<number> = [1,2,3,4]

Nested nodes are allowed:

  metadata: node = {
      timestamp: string = "2026-05-15T22:35:00"
      user: string = "Skybuck"
  }

This allows hierarchical and graph-like structures to be expressed clearly.


3. Graph Semantics
------------------

G-Blocks represent typed labeled graphs.

- Each "node" block is a graph vertex.
- Each "<EdgeName>" is a labeled edge.
- Each "<Value>" is either a literal, an identifier, an array, or another node.
- Arrays represent multi-edges or ordered collections.
- Identifiers represent references to other nodes or symbolic names.

This aligns with GRISP's graph rewrite model:

- Programs are graphs.
- Data is graphs.
- Execution is graph rewriting.


4. Tool Interface Definition
----------------------------

Tools are defined as nodes that describe their parameters and return types.

Example: math.add

  node tool.math.add {
      a: number
      b: number
      returns: number
  }

This defines:

- the tool name: tool.math.add
- the parameter names: a, b
- the parameter types: number, number
- the return type: number

Example: string.concat

  node tool.string.concat {
      a: string
      b: string
      returns: string
  }

Example: sort.asc

  node tool.sort.asc {
      items: array<number>
      returns: array<number>
  }


5. Tool Call Representation
---------------------------

A tool call is represented as a node that specifies:

- which tool is being called
- the arguments and their values

Example: call math.add with a = 5, b = 7

  node call {
      tool: identifier = tool.math.add
      a: number = 5
      b: number = 7
  }

Example: call string.concat with "Hello" and "World"

  node call {
      tool: identifier = tool.string.concat
      a: string = "Hello"
      b: string = "World"
  }

Example: call sort.asc with [5,3,9,1]

  node call {
      tool: identifier = tool.sort.asc
      items: array<number> = [5,3,9,1]
  }


6. Tool Response Representation
-------------------------------

A tool response is also represented as a node.

Example: result of math.add

  node result {
      value: number = 12
  }

Example: result of string.concat

  node result {
      value: string = "HelloWorld"
  }

Example: result of sort.asc

  node result {
      value: array<number> = [1,3,5,9]
  }


7. Design Goals
---------------

G-Blocks were designed to satisfy the following goals:

7.1 Clarity
-----------

Every construct has exactly one meaning. The syntax is simple and regular:

  EdgeName: Type = Value

No hidden rules, no implicit typing, no ambiguous nesting.


7.2 Strong Typing
-----------------

Types are explicit and enforced. This enables:

- static validation
- safer transformations
- clearer contracts between components
- easier integration with strongly typed languages (e.g. Delphi, Rust, Go)


7.3 Graph-Native
----------------

Nodes and edges map directly to graph structures:

- node -> vertex
- edge -> labeled edge
- value -> literal or reference

This makes G-Blocks a natural fit for:

- graph rewriting systems
- GRISP-style computation
- knowledge graphs
- symbolic reasoning


7.4 LLM-Friendly
----------------

G-Blocks avoid common pitfalls for language models:

- no commas to forget
- no braces to mismatch
- no quotes to escape
- no indentation rules
- no deeply nested JSON

The structure is block-based and line-based, which models handle well.


7.5 Implementation-Friendly
---------------------------

G-Blocks are easy to parse and validate in languages like Delphi, C, C++, Go,
Rust, etc. A simple line-based parser can:

- detect node boundaries
- parse edges
- enforce types
- build an in-memory graph representation


7.6 Universal and Scalable
--------------------------

G-Blocks can represent:

- simple tool calls
- complex nested configurations
- large graphs
- protocols
- schemas
- symbolic expressions

The type system and syntax are extensible without breaking existing documents.


8. Comparison to Other Formats
------------------------------

JSON:
- Strengths: ubiquitous, supported everywhere.
- Weaknesses: punctuation-heavy, weak typing, easy to break, hard for LLMs.

XML:
- Strengths: structured, extensible.
- Weaknesses: verbose, noisy, angle-bracket heavy.

YAML:
- Strengths: human-readable.
- Weaknesses: indentation-sensitive, ambiguous, fragile.

S-expressions:
- Strengths: simple, uniform.
- Weaknesses: tree-only, no explicit types, positional arguments.

Protobuf (text/binary):
- Strengths: efficient, typed.
- Weaknesses: not naturally human-readable (binary), schema-dependent.

G-Blocks:
- Strengths: typed, clear, graph-native, human-readable, LLM-friendly.
- Weaknesses: new format (requires tooling and adoption).


9. Formal Grammar (EBNF-style)
------------------------------

This is a simplified EBNF-style grammar for G-Blocks:

  GBlock      = "node", Identifier, "{", { Edge }, "}" ;
  Edge        = Identifier, ":", Type, [ "=", Value ], Newline ;
  Type        = Identifier | ArrayType ;
  ArrayType   = "array", "<", Type, ">" ;
  Value       = Literal | Identifier | Array | NodeBlock ;
  NodeBlock   = "{", { Edge }, "}" ;
  Array       = "[", [ Value, { ",", Value } ], "]" ;
  Literal     = Number | String | Boolean ;

Notes:

- Identifier: a sequence of letters, digits, and underscores, not starting with a digit.
- Number: integer or floating-point literal.
- String: double-quoted text, with standard escaping rules.
- Boolean: "true" or "false".
- Newline: end-of-line marker.

      tool: identifier = tool.sort.asc

  }

Result:

  node result {
      value: array<number> = [1,3,5,9]
  }


11. Conclusion
--------------

G-Blocks are a universal, typed, graph-structured expression format suitable for:

- AI tool interfaces
- symbolic computation
- GRISP-style graph rewriting
- configuration and protocols
- data modeling and knowledge representation

They are:

- crystal clear
- strongly typed
- scalable
- unambiguous
- future-proof
- human-readable
- machine-friendly

G-Blocks provide a shared, precise, elegant way for humans and machines to
express structured information as graphs, making them a powerful foundation for
next-generation systems, tools, and AI interactions.

# NLnet Funding Proposal — GRISP  
### Graph Rewrite Information Symbolic Processor  
### A New AI‑Native Programming Language

## Summary

GRISP is a deterministic, graph‑rewrite symbolic programming language designed for AI‑generated logic, program synthesis, and symbolic reasoning. It provides a safe, explainable execution substrate for AI systems by representing programs, data, and rules as typed graphs.

This proposal requests NLnet funding to develop:

- A graph visualization system  
- A web‑based GRISP playground  
- A debugger and trace engine  
- A standard library of rewrite rules  
- Formal verification tools  

---

## Problem Statement

AI systems generate text, but text is not execution.  
Existing programming languages are not designed for AI‑generated code:

- They are brittle  
- They are unsafe  
- They are not symbolic  
- They are not explainable  
- They are not deterministic  

There is a need for a language that is:

- structured  
- symbolic  
- safe  
- deterministic  
- AI‑friendly  

---

## Solution: GRISP

GRISP uses **graph rewriting** as its execution model.

- Programs are graphs  
- Data is graphs  
- Rewrite rules are graphs  
- Execution is deterministic graph transformation  

The syntax (G‑Blocks) is simple and LLM‑friendly.

GRISP 1.0 already includes:

- Parser  
- Graph engine  
- Pattern matcher  
- Rewrite engine  
- Runtime loop  
- Test suite

Browser‑based GRISP interpreter.

### 3. Debugger  
Step‑through rewrite engine with trace logs.

### 4. Standard Library  
Reusable rewrite rules for math, lists, logic, and symbolic computation.

### 5. Formal Verification  
Rule confluence, termination analysis, and safety proofs.

---

GRISP will enable:

- safer AI‑generated code  
- explainable symbolic reasoning  
- new research in graph rewriting  
- new DSLs and meta‑languages  
- educational tools for symbolic computation  

GRISP aligns strongly with NLnet’s mission of supporting open, secure, and innovative digital infrastructure.

function TGrispPatternMatcher.GetAttributeKeys(Node: TGrispNode): TList<string>;
var
  Key: string;
begin
  Result := TList<string>.Create;
  // Since Attributes is private, we need to access through a different method
  // For now, we'll use a workaround - iterate through known attributes
  // This is a limitation that needs to be addressed in the graph unit
  if Node.HasAttribute('value') then Result.Add('value');
  if Node.HasAttribute('next') then Result.Add('next');
  if Node.HasAttribute('name') then Result.Add('name');
  if Node.HasAttribute('mark') then Result.Add('mark');
  if Node.HasAttribute('phase') then Result.Add('phase');
  if Node.HasAttribute('temp') then Result.Add('temp');
  if Node.HasAttribute('where') then Result.Add('where');
  if Node.HasAttribute('match') then Result.Add('match');
  if Node.HasAttribute('rewrite') then Result.Add('rewrite');
  // Add any other attributes that might exist
  if Node.HasAttribute('minVal') then Result.Add('minVal');
  if Node.HasAttribute('minNode') then Result.Add('minNode');
  if Node.HasAttribute('scanPos') then Result.Add('scanPos');
  if Node.HasAttribute('pass') then Result.Add('pass');
  if Node.HasAttribute('currentMin') then Result.Add('currentMin');
  if Node.HasAttribute('isMin') then Result.Add('isMin');
end;

# =========================================================
# GRISP - Multi-Agent Collaboration Protocol (Version 0.01)
# Designed for AI-to-AI and AI-to-Tool interaction
# =========================================================

namespace AgentCollaboration {

    # ======================
    # Shared Data Structure
    # ======================
    node Task {
        id: string
        description: string
        status: ("pending" | "in_progress" | "completed" | "failed")
        priority: number
        assigned_to: identifier
        result: value?
    }

    # ======================
    # Core Communication Rules
    # ======================

    # Rule 1: Planner sends task to Specialist
    node rule.DelegateTask {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = { type = "Planner" }
            Task: node = {
                status = "pending"
                assigned_to = null
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = { type = "Planner" }
            Specialist: node = { type = "Specialist" }
            Task: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                assigned_to = Specialist
            }
            Message: node = {
                type = "TaskAssigned"
                content = Task
                from = Planner
                to = Specialist
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 2: Specialist processes task and returns result
    node rule.ProcessAndReturn {
        match: graph = {
            Specialist: node = { type = "Specialist" }
            Task: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                assigned_to = Specialist
                description = Desc
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Specialist: node = { type = "Specialist" }
            Task: node = {
                status = "completed"
                result = ExecuteTool(Desc)          # Calls external tool
            }
            Message: node = {
                type = "TaskCompleted"
                content = Task
                from = Specialist
                to = "Planner"
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 3: Planner aggregates multiple results (AI-to-AI synthesis)
    node rule.SynthesizeResults {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = { type = "Planner" }
            Tasks: many node = {
                status = "completed"
                result = Result
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = { type = "Planner" }
            FinalReport: node = {
                type = "FinalAnswer"
                content = MergeResults(Tasks)
                confidence = CalculateConfidence(Tasks)
            }
        }
    }

    # ======================
    # Tool Integration Layer (AI -> External Tool)
    # ======================

    node tool.WebSearch {
        input: string
        output: {
            success: boolean
            data: json?
            error: string?
        }
    }

    node tool.CodeExecution {
        language: ("delphi" | "python" | "pascal")
        code: string
        output: string
    }

    # Example of AI generating safe tool call via GRISP
    node rule.SafeCodeExecution {
        match: graph = {
            AI: node = { type = "CoderAI" }
            Request: node = {
                type = "ExecuteCode"
                code = Code
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            AI: node = { type = "CoderAI" }
            Result: node = tool.CodeExecution {
                language = "delphi"
                code = Code
            }
        }
    }
}

# ===================================================
# GRISP - Agent Collaboration Protocol (Version 0.02)
# With goals, retries, and edge-based assignment
# ===================================================

namespace AgentCollaborationV002 {

    # ======================
    # Core Entity Types
    # ======================

    node Agent {
        id: identifier
        role: ("Planner" | "Specialist")
        capabilities: array<identifier>      # e.g. ["plan", "code", "search", "execute"]
        state: identifier                    # e.g. "idle", "busy"
    }

    node Goal {
        id: identifier
        description: string
        status: ("pending" | "in_progress" | "completed" | "failed")
        created_at: number
        updated_at: number
        tags: array<identifier>
    }

    node Task {
        id: identifier
        description: string
        status: ("pending" | "assigned" | "in_progress" | "waiting_tool" | "completed" | "failed")
        priority: number
        created_at: number
        updated_at: number
        retries: number
        max_retries: number
        result: value?
        error: string?
        tags: array<identifier>
    }

    node Message {
        id: identifier
        type: identifier                      # "TaskAssigned" | "TaskCompleted" | "TaskFailed" | "GoalCompleted"
        from: node<Agent>
        to: node<Agent>
        payload: node<Task>?
        goal: node<Goal>?
    }

    node ToolRequest {
        id: identifier
        kind: ("WebSearch" | "CodeExecution")
        input: value
        status: ("pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed")
        created_at: number
        task: node<Task>
    }

    node ToolResult {
        id: identifier
        request: node<ToolRequest>
        success: boolean
        data: value?
        error: string?
    }

    node FinalAnswer {
        id: identifier
        goal: node<Goal>
        content: value
        confidence: number
        source_tasks: array<node<Task>>
    }

    # ======================
    # Structural Edges
    # ======================

    edge assigns {
        from: Agent
        to: Task
        label: "assigned"
        type: "agent_task"
    }

    edge belongs_to_goal {
        from: Task
        to: Goal
        label: "belongs_to"
        type: "task_goal"
    }

    edge communicates {
        from: Agent
        to: Message
        label: "sends"
        type: "agent_message"
    }

    edge about_task {
        from: Message
        to: Task
        label: "about"
        type: "message_task"
    }

    edge about_goal {
        from: Message
        to: Goal
        label: "about_goal"
        type: "message_goal"
    }

    edge tool_for_task {
        from: ToolRequest
        to: Task
        label: "for"
        type: "tool_task"
    }

    edge result_of_request {
        from: ToolResult
        to: ToolRequest
        label: "result_of"
        type: "tool_result"
    }

    # ======================
    # Core Agentic Rules
    # ======================

    # Rule 1: Planner delegates a pending task of a goal to a capable Specialist
    node rule.DelegateTask {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "pending"
                retries <= max_retries
            }

            edge belongs_to_goal {
                from: Task
                to: Goal
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = "idle"
                capabilities contains "execute"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = "busy"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "assigned"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }

            Msg: node = {
                type = "TaskAssigned"
                from = Planner
                to = Specialist
                payload = Task
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge communicates {
                from: Planner
                to: Msg
            }

            edge about_task {
                from: Msg
                to: Task
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 2: Specialist starts working on an assigned task
    node rule.StartTaskWork {
        match: graph = {
            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = "busy"
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "assigned"
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = "busy"
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                updated_at = Now()
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 3: Specialist decides a tool is needed and creates a ToolRequest
    node rule.CreateToolRequest {
        match: graph = {
            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = "busy"
                capabilities contains "tool_call"
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                description = Desc
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = "busy"
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "waiting_tool"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                id = NewId()
                kind = DecideToolKind(Desc)
                input = Desc
                status = "pending"
                created_at = Now()
                task = Task
            }

            edge tool_for_task {
                from: ToolReq
                to: Task
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 4: Runtime marks a pending ToolRequest as running (side-effect boundary)
    node rule.MarkToolRunning {
        match: graph = {
            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "pending"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "running"
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 5: Integrate successful ToolResult, complete task, maybe complete goal
    node rule.IntegrateToolResultSuccess {
        match: graph = {
            ToolRes: node = ToolResult {
                success = true
                request = ToolReq
            }

            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "completed"
                task = Task
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "waiting_tool"
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = "busy"
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            edge belongs_to_goal {
                from: Task
                to: Goal
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Task: node = {
                status = "completed"
                result = ToolRes.data
                updated_at = Now()
                error = ""
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = "idle"
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            edge result_of_request {
                from: ToolRes
                to: ToolReq
            }

            Msg: node = {
                type = "TaskCompleted"
                from = Specialist
                to = Planner
                payload = Task
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge communicates {
                from: Specialist
                to: Msg
            }

            edge about_task {
                from: Msg
                to: Task
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 6: Integrate failed ToolResult, retry or fail task
    node rule.IntegrateToolResultFailure {
        match: graph = {
            ToolRes: node = ToolResult {
                success = false
                request = ToolReq
            }

            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "failed"
                task = Task
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "waiting_tool"
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = "busy"
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            edge belongs_to_goal {
                from: Task
                to: Goal
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Task: node = {
                status = (Task.retries + 1 <= Task.max_retries) ? "pending" : "failed"
                retries = Task.retries + 1
                error = ToolRes.error
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                state = (Task.retries + 1 <= Task.max_retries) ? "idle" : "idle"
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            edge result_of_request {
                from: ToolRes
                to: ToolReq
            }

            Msg: node = {
                type = (Task.retries + 1 <= Task.max_retries) ? "TaskRetryScheduled" : "TaskFailed"
                from = Specialist
                to = Planner
                payload = Task
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge communicates {
                from: Specialist
                to: Msg
            }

            edge about_task {
                from: Msg
                to: Task
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 7: Planner synthesizes results for a single goal into a FinalAnswer
    node rule.SynthesizeGoalResults {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["in_progress", "pending"]
            }

            Tasks: many node = {
                status = "completed"
            }

            edges: many belongs_to_goal {
                from: Tasks
                to: Goal
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "completed"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            Answer: node = FinalAnswer {
                id = NewId()
                goal = Goal
                content = MergeResults(Tasks)
                confidence = CalculateConfidence(Tasks)
                source_tasks = Tasks
            }

            Msg: node = {
                type = "GoalCompleted"
                from = Planner
                to = Planner
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Pure Helper Functions
    # ======================

    fn Now(): number
    fn NewId(): identifier
    fn DecideToolKind(desc: string): ("WebSearch" | "CodeExecution")
    fn MergeResults(tasks: array<node<Task>>): value
    fn CalculateConfidence(tasks: array<node<Task>>): number

# ===================================================
# GRISP - Agent Collaboration Protocol (Version 0.03)
# Goals, retries, clean assignment, and strategy
# ===================================================

namespace AgentCollaborationV003 {

    # ======================
    # Core Entity Types
    # ======================

    node Agent {
        id: identifier
        role: ("Planner" | "Specialist")
        capabilities: array<identifier>      # e.g. ["plan", "code", "search", "execute", "tool_call"]
        # state is now derived from graph (assigned edges), not authoritative
    }

    node Goal {
        id: identifier
        description: string
        status: ("pending" | "in_progress" | "completed" | "failed")
        created_at: number
        updated_at: number
        tags: array<identifier>
    }

    node Task {
        id: identifier
        description: string
        status: ("pending" | "assigned" | "in_progress" | "waiting_tool" | "completed" | "failed")
        priority: number
        created_at: number
        updated_at: number
        retries: number
        max_retries: number
        result: value?
        error: string?
        tags: array<identifier>
    }

    node Message {
        id: identifier
        type: identifier                      # "TaskAssigned" | "TaskCompleted" | "TaskFailed" | "TaskRetryScheduled" | "GoalCompleted" | "GoalFailed"
        from: node<Agent>
        to: node<Agent>
        payload: node<Task>?
        goal: node<Goal>?
    }

    node ToolRequest {
        id: identifier
        kind: ("WebSearch" | "CodeExecution")
        input: value
        status: ("pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed")
        created_at: number
        task: node<Task>
    }

    node ToolResult {
        id: identifier
        request: node<ToolRequest>
        success: boolean
        data: value?
        error: string?
    }

    node FinalAnswer {
        id: identifier
        goal: node<Goal>
        content: value
        confidence: number
        source_tasks: array<node<Task>>
    }

    # ======================
    # Structural Edges
    # ======================

    edge assigns {
        from: Agent
        to: Task
        label: "assigned"
        type: "agent_task"
    }

    edge belongs_to_goal {
        from: Task
        to: Goal
        label: "belongs_to"
        type: "task_goal"
    }

    edge communicates {
        from: Agent
        to: Message
        label: "sends"
        type: "agent_message"
    }

    edge about_task {
        from: Message
        to: Task
        label: "about"
        type: "message_task"
    }

    edge about_goal {
        from: Message
        to: Goal
        label: "about_goal"
        type: "message_goal"
    }

    edge tool_for_task {
        from: ToolRequest
        to: Task
        label: "for"
        type: "tool_task"
    }

    edge result_of_request {
        from: ToolResult
        to: ToolRequest
        label: "result_of"
        type: "tool_result"
    }

    # ======================
    # Core Agentic Rules
    # ======================

    # Rule 1: Planner delegates a pending task of a goal to a capable Specialist
    node rule.DelegateTask {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "pending"
                retries <= max_retries
            }

            edge belongs_to_goal {
                from: Task
                to: Goal
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                capabilities contains "execute"
            }

            # Specialist is considered idle if it has no assigns edge to an active task
            not exists edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: AnyTask where AnyTask.status in ["assigned", "in_progress", "waiting_tool"]
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "assigned"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }

            Msg: node = {
                type = "TaskAssigned"
                from = Planner
                to = Specialist
                payload = Task
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge communicates {
                from: Planner
                to: Msg
            }

            edge about_task {
                from: Msg
                to: Task
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 2: Specialist starts working on an assigned task
    node rule.StartTaskWork {
        match: graph = {
            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "assigned"
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                updated_at = Now()
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 3: Specialist decides a tool is needed and creates a ToolRequest
    node rule.CreateToolRequest {
        match: graph = {
            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
                capabilities contains "tool_call"
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                description = Desc
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }

            # Prevent duplicate tool requests for the same task
            not exists ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                task = Task
                status in ["pending", "running"]
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "waiting_tool"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                id = NewId()
                kind = DecideToolKind(Desc)
                input = Desc
                status = "pending"
                created_at = Now()
                task = Task
            }

            edge tool_for_task {
                from: ToolReq
                to: Task
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 4: Runtime marks a pending ToolRequest as running (side-effect boundary)
    node rule.MarkToolRunning {
        match: graph = {
            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "pending"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "running"
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 5: Integrate successful ToolResult, complete task, clean assignment
    node rule.IntegrateToolResultSuccess {
        match: graph = {
            ToolRes: node = ToolResult {
                success = true
                request = ToolReq
            }

            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "completed"
                task = Task
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "waiting_tool"
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            edge belongs_to_goal {
                from: Task
                to: Goal
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Task: node = {
                status = "completed"
                result = ToolRes.data
                updated_at = Now()
                error = ""
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = Goal.status   # may be updated by synthesis later
            }

            edge result_of_request {
                from: ToolRes
                to: ToolReq
            }

            # Remove assignment edge: specialist is now free for other tasks
            delete edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }

            Msg: node = {
                type = "TaskCompleted"
                from = Specialist
                to = Planner
                payload = Task
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge communicates {
                from: Specialist
                to: Msg
            }

            edge about_task {
                from: Msg
                to: Task
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 6: Integrate failed ToolResult, retry or fail task, clean assignment when done
    node rule.IntegrateToolResultFailure {
        match: graph = {
            ToolRes: node = ToolResult {
                success = false
                request = ToolReq
            }

            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "failed"
                task = Task
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "waiting_tool"
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            edge belongs_to_goal {
                from: Task
                to: Goal
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Task: node = {
                status = (Task.retries + 1 <= Task.max_retries) ? "pending" : "failed"
                retries = Task.retries + 1
                error = ToolRes.error
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = Goal.status
            }

            edge result_of_request {
                from: ToolRes
                to: ToolReq
            }

            # If task is permanently failed, free the specialist
            maybe delete edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            } when Task.status = "failed"

            Msg: node = {
                type = (Task.retries + 1 <= Task.max_retries) ? "TaskRetryScheduled" : "TaskFailed"
                from = Specialist
                to = Planner
                payload = Task
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge communicates {
                from: Specialist
                to: Msg
            }

            edge about_task {
                from: Msg
                to: Task
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 7: Fail a goal if any of its tasks has permanently failed
    node rule.FailGoal {
        match: graph = {
            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            FailedTask: node = {
                status = "failed"
            }

            edge belongs_to_goal {
                from: FailedTask
                to: Goal
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Goal: node = {
                status = "failed"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Msg: node = {
                type = "GoalFailed"
                from = Planner
                to = Planner
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule 8: Planner synthesizes results for a single goal into a FinalAnswer
    node rule.SynthesizeGoalResults {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            # All tasks for this goal must be completed (no pending/assigned/in_progress/waiting_tool/failed)
            condition AllTasksCompleted(Goal) = true

            CompletedTasks: many node = {
                status = "completed"
            }

            edges: many belongs_to_goal {
                from: CompletedTasks
                to: Goal
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "completed"
                updated_at = Now()

            Answer: node = FinalAnswer {

                content = MergeResults(CompletedTasks)
                confidence = CalculateConfidence(CompletedTasks)
                source_tasks = CompletedTasks

            Msg: node = {
                type = "GoalCompleted"
                from = Planner
                to = Planner
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # ======================
    # Strategy (Execution Semantics)
    # ======================

    strategy AgentLoop {
        repeat {
            phase 1 {
                apply DelegateTask;
            }
            phase 2 {
                apply StartTaskWork;
            }
            phase 3 {
                apply CreateToolRequest;
            }
            phase 4 {
                apply MarkToolRunning;
                apply IntegrateToolResultSuccess;
                apply IntegrateToolResultFailure;
            }
            phase 5 {
                apply FailGoal;
                apply SynthesizeGoalResults;
            }
        }
    }

namespace AgentCollaborationV004 {

    # ======================

        error: string?

    # Rule P1: Decompose a complex goal into subgoals
    node rule.DecomposeGoal {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
                capabilities contains "plan"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "pending"
                tags contains "complex"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            # Example decomposition into two subgoals (real patterns can be domain-specific)
            SubGoalA: node = Goal {
                id = NewId()
                description = Goal.description + " / Phase A"
                status = "pending"
                created_at = Now()
                updated_at = Now()
                tags = Goal.tags
            }

            SubGoalB: node = Goal {
                id = NewId()
                description = Goal.description + " / Phase B"
                status = "pending"
                created_at = Now()
                updated_at = Now()
                tags = Goal.tags
            }

            edge subgoal_of {
                from: SubGoalA
                to: Goal
            }

            edge subgoal_of {
                from: SubGoalB
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule P2: Complete a parent goal when all its subgoals are completed
    node rule.CompleteParentGoal {

            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                id = NewId()
                kind = DecideToolKind(Desc)
                input = Desc
                status = "pending"
                created_at = Now()
                task = Task
            }

            edge tool_for_task {
                from: ToolReq
                to: Task
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule T4: MarkToolRunning (runtime boundary, unchanged)
    node rule.MarkToolRunning {
        match: graph = {
            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "pending"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "running"
            }
        }

    # Rule T5: Integrate successful ToolResult (same as V003, plus optional ToolRequest cleanup policy)
    node rule.IntegrateToolResultSuccess {
        match: graph = {
            ToolRes: node = ToolResult {
                success = true
                request = ToolReq
            }

            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "completed"
                task = Task

            Task: node = {
                status = "waiting_tool"

                role = "Specialist"

                from: Specialist
                to: Task

            Goal: node = {

                status = "completed"

                updated_at = Now()

                role = "Planner"

            Goal: node = {

            # delete ToolReq

            Msg: node = {

                to = Planner
                payload = Task
                goal = Goal

                from: Specialist
                to: Msg
            }

            edge about_task {
                from: Msg
                to: Task
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule T6: Integrate failed ToolResult with clean retry semantics
    node rule.IntegrateToolResultFailure {
        match: graph = {
            ToolRes: node = ToolResult {
                success = false
                request = ToolReq
            }

            ToolReq: node = ToolRequest {
                status = "failed"
                task = Task
            }

            Task: node = {
                status = "waiting_tool"
            }

            Specialist: node = {
                role = "Specialist"
            }

            edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            edge belongs_to_goal {
                from: Task
                to: Goal
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            # Precompute whether this failure is final
            WillFail: value = (Task.retries + 1 > Task.max_retries)

            Task: node = {
                status = (WillFail ? "failed" : "pending")
                retries = Task.retries + 1
                error = ToolRes.error
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = Goal.status
            }

            edge result_of_request {
                from: ToolRes
                to: ToolReq
            }

            # If permanently failed, free specialist
            maybe delete edge assigns {
                from: Specialist
                to: Task
            } when WillFail = true

            Msg: node = {
                type = (WillFail ? "TaskFailed" : "TaskRetryScheduled")
                from = Specialist
                to = Planner
                payload = Task
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge communicates {
                from: Specialist
                to: Msg
            }

            edge about_task {
                from: Msg
                to: Task
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule T7: Fail a goal if any of its tasks has permanently failed (same idea as V003)
    node rule.FailGoal {
        match: graph = {
            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            FailedTask: node = {
                status = "failed"
            }

            edge belongs_to_goal {
                from: FailedTask
                to: Goal
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Goal: node = {
                status = "failed"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Msg: node = {
                type = "GoalFailed"
                from = Planner
                to = Planner
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # Rule T8: Synthesize results for a leaf goal (no subgoals) into a FinalAnswer
    node rule.SynthesizeGoalResults {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status in ["pending", "in_progress"]
            }

            # Only synthesize for goals that have no subgoals (leaf goals)
            condition IsLeafGoal(Goal) = true

            # All tasks for this goal must be completed
            condition AllTasksCompleted(Goal) = true

            CompletedTasks: many node = {
                status = "completed"
            }

            edges: many belongs_to_goal {
                from: CompletedTasks
                to: Goal
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "completed"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            Answer: node = FinalAnswer {
                id = NewId()
                goal = Goal
                content = MergeResults(CompletedTasks)
                confidence = CalculateConfidence(CompletedTasks)
                source_tasks = CompletedTasks
            }

            Msg: node = {
                type = "GoalCompleted"
                from = Planner
                to = Planner
                goal = Goal
            }

            edge about_goal {
                from: Msg
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # ======================
    # Strategy (Execution Semantics)
    # ======================

    strategy AgentLoop {
        repeat {
            phase 1 {
                apply DecomposeGoal;
            }
            phase 2 {
                apply DelegateTask;
            }
            phase 3 {
                apply StartTaskWork;
            }
            phase 4 {
                apply CreateToolRequest;
            }
            phase 5 {
                apply MarkToolRunning;
                apply IntegrateToolResultSuccess;
                apply IntegrateToolResultFailure;
            }
            phase 6 {
                apply FailGoal;
                apply SynthesizeGoalResults;
                apply CompleteParentGoal;
                apply PropagateGoalFailure;
            }
        }
    }

    # ======================
    # Helper Functions (runtime / query layer)
    # ======================

    fn Now(): number
    fn NewId(): identifier
    fn DecideToolKind(desc: string): ("WebSearch" | "CodeExecution")

    fn AllTasksCompleted(goal: node<Goal>): boolean
    fn AllSubGoalsCompleted(goal: node<Goal>): boolean

    fn IsLeafGoal(goal: node<Goal>): boolean

namespace AgentCollaborationV005 {

    # ======================
    # Core Entity Types
    # ======================

    node Agent {
        id: identifier
        role: ("Planner" | "Specialist")
        capabilities: array<identifier>      # e.g. ["plan", "code", "search", "execute", "tool_call"]
        capacity: number                     # total capacity units
    }

    node Goal {
        id: identifier
        description: string
        status: ("pending" | "in_progress" | "completed" | "failed")
        created_at: number
        updated_at: number
        tags: array<identifier>              # e.g. ["complex", "compiler", "analysis"]
        failure_policy: ("fail_fast" | "best_effort" | "majority")
    }

    node Task {
        id: identifier
        description: string
        status: ("pending" | "assigned" | "in_progress" | "waiting_tool" | "completed" | "failed")
        priority: number
        created_at: number
        updated_at: number
        retries: number
        max_retries: number
        result: value?
        error: string?
        tags: array<identifier>              # e.g. ["code", "search", "analysis"]
        cost: number                         # capacity units required
    }

    node Message {
        id: identifier
        type: identifier
        from: node<Agent>
        to: node<Agent>
        payload: node<Task>?
        goal: node<Goal>?
    }

    node ToolRequest {
        id: identifier
        kind: ("WebSearch" | "CodeExecution")
        input: value
        status: ("pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed")
        created_at: number
        task: node<Task>
    }

    node ToolResult {
        id: identifier
        request: node<ToolRequest>
        success: boolean
        data: value?
        error: string?
    }

    # NEW: planning as a first-class external action
    node PlanningRequest {
        id: identifier
        goal: node<Goal>
        status: ("pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed")
        created_at: number
        # optional hints for the planner
        hint: value?
    }

    node PlanningResult {
        id: identifier
        request: node<PlanningRequest>
        success: boolean
        # abstract plan structure; interpreted by ApplyPlanningResult
        plan: value?
        error: string?
    }

    node FinalAnswer {
        id: identifier
        goal: node<Goal>
        content: value
        confidence: number
        source_tasks: array<node<Task>>
    }

    # PR1: Request a plan for a complex goal
    node rule.CreatePlanningRequest {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
                capabilities contains "plan"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "pending"
                tags contains "complex"
            }

            # avoid duplicate planning requests
            not exists PR: node = PlanningRequest {
                goal = Goal
                status in ["pending", "running"]
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            PR: node = PlanningRequest {
                id = NewId()
                goal = Goal
                status = "pending"
                created_at = Now()
                hint = Goal.tags
            }

            edge planning_for_goal {
                from: PR
                to: Goal
            }
        }
    }

    # PR2: Mark planning request as running (runtime boundary)
    node rule.MarkPlanningRunning {
        match: graph = {
            PR: node = PlanningRequest {
                status = "pending"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            PR: node = PlanningRequest {
                status = "running"
            }
        }
    }

    # PR3: Apply a successful planning result: create subgoals and/or tasks
    # (plan structure is interpreted by helper functions)
    node rule.ApplyPlanningResultSuccess {
        match: graph = {
            PR: node = PlanningRequest {
                status = "completed"
                goal = Goal
            }

            PlanRes: node = PlanningResult {
                request = PR
                success = true
                plan = PlanData
            }

            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }
        }

        rewrite: graph = {
            Planner: node = {
                role = "Planner"
            }

            Goal: node = {
                status = "in_progress"
                updated_at = Now()
            }

            edge result_of_planning {
                from: PlanRes
                to: PR
            }

            # Create subgoals and tasks according to the plan
            # These helpers expand PlanData into concrete nodes/edges
            call CreateSubGoalsFromPlan(Goal, PlanData);
            call CreateTasksFromPlan(Goal, PlanData);
        }

    # T1: Delegate a pending, dependency-satisfied task to a capable Specialist with enough capacity
    node rule.DelegateTask {
        match: graph = {
            Planner: node = {

            # Capability-based routing
            condition CanExecute(Specialist, Task) = true

            # Capacity check

        rewrite: graph = {

                role = "Planner"
